author: fxeyes
text:
nsikandar wrote:

Astrokillah wrote: DP = Decision Point, Decision to Break, Decision to Engulf

Both A and B are DP.

Hi Astro

Yes I agree, my initial thought was the same but I was confused why A was the stronger one to hold down price at the far right instead of B

Also it makes a nice BSZ to stop breakout traders

In this case, there were more orders above B, so it’s very likely that price will want to go higher before turning down. You can see that right above B, at the bottom of A, there was an MPL that price turned at. Then there was an even higher set of orders at the top of A. Remember price CAN turn at any DP, the last set of orders is the safest bet. Until then, be conservative with your tg1.
